recentItems.title: Tom Ellis & Nick Gehlfuss Reveal All: CIA Cast Pop Quiz
recentItems.description:
Watch CIA stars Tom Ellis and Nick Gehlfuss pop balloons to tackle hilarious fan questions and behind-the-scenes secrets from their hit CBS series! They reveal character quirks, guilty pleasures, and off-screen habits.
Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #CIACBS
Follow CIA on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/fbicbs
Follow CIA on TikTok HERE: https://www.tiktok.com/@fbiscbs
Like CIA on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/FBICBS
Watch more CIA HERE: https://www.paramountplus.com/shows/cia

CIA focuses on a clandestine CIA/FBI task force where secretive and roguish CIA Agent Colin Glass finds himself teamed up with by-the-book FBI Special Agent Bill Goodman. The duo work together on covert operations in New York, uncovering international plots, terrorist cells and geopolitical secrets. Also on the team is Deputy Chief of Station Nikki Reynard and CIA Analyst Gina Gosian. On CIA, Bill continues to learn the rules of this murky world on the fly as Colin leads him deeper into spy games where only one thing is clear – their work keeps America safe, even if no one will ever know what they did in the shadows.

Key Questions Answered
* What snack does Nick Gehlfuss consider his ultimate guilty pleasure?
* What core trait does Tom Ellis actually share with his character on CIA?
* What is Tom Ellis’s zodiac sign, and does he believe he matches its reputation?
* Which unexpected classic hit songs feature on an undercover spy’s workout playlist?
* Does Nick Gehlfuss think he would actually get along with his character in real life?
* What everyday beverage habit completely baffles the cast behind the scenes?

Timestamps/Chapters
0:00 Balloon Pop Rules: Blue vs Silver Questions
0:16 Nick's Secret Guilty Pleasure
0:30 Tom's Connection to His Character
0:46 Astrology and Scorpio Traits

1:59 The Great Coffee Debate

Play-by-Play Overview Tom Ellis and Nick Gehlfuss launch into a balloon-popping trivia challenge where balloon confetti colors choose their fate: blue yields questions about their roles on CBS’s CIA, while silver demands candid personal truths.
Nick kicks things off by confessing an unusual lunchtime habit: adding crunchy potato chips directly into his sandwiches. Tom then pulls a show card and reflects on what binds him to his character, noting they share a disciplined, strict regimen that keeps him grounded.
The conversation pivots to personal territory when Tom reveals he is a Scorpio, joking about past relationship critiques and laughingly confirming that he possesses an unmistakable sting in his tail.
Shifting back to character preparation, the duo brainstorms hypothetical playlists, pitching anthems ranging from classic Bruce Springsteen tracks to dramatic 80s pop ballads.
Nick then contemplates whether he could ever be friends with his own character, concluding they would hit it off over drinks down at a local pub.
The segment ends on an unexpected personal reveal when Nick admits he has never tasted coffee in his entire life and never intends to start, leaving Tom amused and thankful for an endless source of playful banter on set.

SHERIFF COUNTRY stars Morena Baccarin as straight-shooting sheriff Mickey Fox, the stepsister of Cal Fire’s division chief Sharon Leone (Diane Farr of Fire Country). She investigates criminal activity while she patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater, contending with her ex-con father, Wes (W. Earl Brown), who is an off-the-grid marijuana grower, and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter. SHERIFF COUNTRY is an expansion of the universe of the hit drama series FIRE COUNTRY.

Key Questions Answered
What superpower would Morena Baccarin choose?
Who is Morena Baccarin's dream guest star on Sheriff Country?
How has working on Sheriff Country changed Morena Baccarin's life?
What is Morena Baccarin's morning habit regarding brushing her teeth?

Play-by-Play Overview
Morena Baccarin kicks off the video by introducing the CBS Pop Quiz, explaining that popping balloons reveals confetti colors that match specific question bowls.
She pops her first silver balloon and answers what superpower she would want, jokingly choosing the power to make everyone good. Next, she pops a blue balloon to reveal a question about her dream guest star on Sheriff Country.
Popping another blue balloon, Morena reflects on how starring in Sheriff Country has impacted her life, highlighting the strong bond of her work family and the thrill of being in charge on set.
Moving through the game, she pops a silver balloon and reacts playfully to a question about her most-used emoji, declaring it a secret too private to share on camera. She then answers a quick lifestyle question, confirming she always brushes her teeth immediately upon waking up.   Looking ahead, Morena pops a balloon to discuss her excitement for Sheriff Country Season 2, sharing how eager she is to see where Sheriff Mickey's harrowing journey leads next.
To wrap up the quiz, she reflects on her favorite moments from Season 1, noting that while big action sequences are thrilling, her absolute favorite scenes are the quiet, conversational moments walking through the station and teasing castmates about their love lives.
